CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)
New Delhi, the 23rd June, 2026
The undersigned is directed to say that with effect from 23rd June, 2026, Shri
George Kurian relinquished the charge of the office of the Minister of State in the
Ministry of Minority Affairs; and the Minister of State in the Ministry of Fisheries,
Animal Husbandry and Dairying.
